slides.title: Anthropic Scion Replaces Git Anthropic replaces Git with
slides.text: Anthropic Scion Replaces Git Anthropic replaces Git with Scion after Claude passes 30K merges a day Git could not keep up with the speed of AI work done by Claude Daily merges grew from about 2.5K in May to over 30K in Sept A team of seven built Scion - a server-centric version control system Plus Antique - an AI-assisted code review tool CPU and memory use fell x200 Speed improved (from mins to secs) Git: Client: “I want E; I have C.” Server determines the objects needed and constructs a custom transfer pack - then sends it Scion: Client discovers E’s trees and checks its local object store. Client requests specific missing objects from caches. Cache streams the requested objects in ready-to-user format. No packing needed. The main gains come from using cached objects https://alphasignal.ai/email/1b36e75b14af56e6 https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/redesigning-source-control

slides.title: AI News Meta releases Muse Wonder, its first
slides.text: AI News Meta releases Muse Wonder, its first frontier-class models Two models: Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full Wonder Full scores 56 on the Artificial Analysis Index, second only to Claude Opus 5.5 Beats Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra at legal work, long coding and memory Active Memory keeps context across days, weeks and months Leaked pricing: $4 input, $20 output per 1M tokens, 1M context Closed weights; Wonder Full only on Muse Code plans at $50 or $200 a month https://research.meta.ai/blog/muse-wonder Meta releases Muse Spark Open 816B open-weight model Best Western open model so far Multimodal MoE: 816B total, 42B active, 1M-token context Built for coding and long-horizon agents Runs locally on two M5 Ultra Mac Studios over Apple's MLX Scores 39 on the AA Intelligence Index (Meta's closed Muse Wonder scores 52) Compare: GLM 5.3 (45), Kimi K3 (44) and Qwen3.8 (40) License: model-serving firms over $20M revenue need a separate deal https://research.meta.ai/blog/muse-spark-open

slides.title: AI News ArtCraft and AI Reverse Engineering Developer
slides.text: AI News ArtCraft and AI Reverse Engineering Developer Brandon Thomas released ArtCraft - a set of 7 free, open-source Adobe alternatives built with Rust and Claude for Windows, macOS, and Linux https://getartcraft.com https://github.com/storytold https://www.linkedin.com/in/possibilistic/ - Brandon's Linkedin - Atlanta, Georgia He describes these as clean-room re-implementations, not reconstructed Adobe source code The Fireship's tests conclude that it is not a production-ready Adobe replacement yet Reverse Engineer Anything (REA) - connects AI agents with binary-inspection tools such as Ghidra, helping developers analyze behavior and guide custom implementations - https://github.com/morluto/rea The achievement is faster, accessible software experimentation - not making every proprietary application open source or rendering Adobe obsolete overnight https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wajoP_5Cpw8 -video

slides.title: AI News Claude Code: Less Micromanagement Boris Cherny
slides.text: AI News Claude Code: Less Micromanagement Boris Cherny : in January - planning advice today - favoring autonomous execution Define tasks, guardrails, and completion criteria Review results instead of prescribing every step Keep recommended effort settings Provide executable checks that prove success Use continuation loops to fix failures without repeated “continue” Keep CLAUDE.md concise Build skills from observed mistakes, then compare performance with and without them Enforce critical restrictions through hooks Limit subagents and automate recurring workflows The central achievement is reduced supervision while retaining verifiable outputs https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J9NQTYUP6k 0

slides.title: Local AI More Expensive Than Claude? Local AI
slides.text: Local AI More Expensive Than Claude? Local AI vs Cloud: True Costs Haiku 5.5 $0.50 per 1M output tokens, plus input charges. Compare with using local NVIDIA RTX 4090 - $0.47–$0.50 Hardware amortization makes lightly used GPUs substantially more expensive Speed, quality, and context length also matter Cloud providers use parallel batching - it dramatically lowers costs https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yaXgmGPZUOg MS Windows Hybrid AI Microsoft’s Satya Nadella and Nvidia’s Jensen Huang outlined Windows “hybrid intelligence.” Windows would route AI tasks between local hardware and cloud models, addressing agent costs, privacy, latency, and offline access Copilot would gain permission-based file access, local models, and PC actions; execution containers and separate agent identities would constrain access and enable monitoring. Claimed advances include Nvidia RTX Spark hardware, Surface Laptop Ultra, compressed coding models, and Microsoft Decision 1, reportedly 35 times faster than GPT6. The significance is a shift toward agent-operated PCs https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ApsNLVLRvu0

slides.title: AI News Deno Joins Cloudflare Deno is an
slides.text: AI News Deno Joins Cloudflare Deno is an open-source runtime for running JavaScript, TypeScript, and WebAssembly outside the browser https://docs.deno.com/runtime/ Cloudflare acquires Deno's team and their celld technology Cloudflare is not interested in Deno itself - Deno maintenance will discontinue in 1 year, its code remains open source The team will merge celld with workerd celld - an open-source system for running and coordinating Workers-compatible applications and persistent Durable Objects across your own servers https://celld.dev https://github.com/denoland/celld workerd - Cloudflare’s open-source runtime for executing Workers applications on your own infrastructure https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd https://blog.cloudflare.com/workerd-open-source-workers-runtime/ This is a foundation for AI-agent infrastructure: it makes it easier to host many persistent, stateful agent sessions Deno’s announcement explicitly identifies Durable Objects as useful for agent harnesses because they combine serverless execution, persistent state, WebSockets, and a JavaScript interface One Durable Object per agent session, task, or user. Each object is an individually addressable, single-threaded execution unit with its own SQLite database; the platform handles distributing objects across machines. https://blog.cloudflare.com/deno-joins-cloudflare/ https://deno.com/blog/cloudflare

slides.title: AI News Claude Motion In Beta for Team
slides.text: AI News Claude Motion In Beta for Team and Enterprise Turns supplied content and data into editable, code-based animated explainers, charts, product walkthroughs, and presentation visuals Available inside Claude, with editing through conversation or an editor and export to MP4 Users describe their goals and ask Claude to generate and revise text, numbers, graphics, and timing https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17454997-get-started-with-claude-motion https://claude.com/resources/articles/dashboards-and-motion AstaBrief 8B - Generates Science Reports Ai2, the Allen Institute for AI, released AstaBrief 8B on Hugging Face https://huggingface.co/blog/allenai/astabrief Built on Qwen3-8B It turns questions and supplied scientific excerpts into cited reports; the model itself does not search online https://huggingface.co/allenai/AstaBrief_8B Asta’s Fast pipeline averages 51.1 seconds, approximately 3.5 times faster than Thinking mode. High precision and citation recall Open weights and training data enable local deployment, customization, and greater privacy for sensitive research

slides.title: AI News TurboPuffer - RIP Vectors turbopuffer is
slides.text: AI News TurboPuffer - RIP Vectors turbopuffer is a managed search AI - https://turbopuffer.com The v3 redesign: document IDs replace vectors as primary storage keys https://turbopuffer.com/blog/rip-vector-database https://turbopuffer.com/v3 Serving AI applications including Cursor, Notion, and Anthropic, the company illustrates a shift: vector search becomes one tool, not the architecture’s center. Three alternatives emerge: iterative agent search, live MCP connectors, and precompiled knowledge files Agents are the best for complex questions, but higher costs and latency Compiled wikis also show substantial overhead Keyword search handles enterprise identifiers Vectors help recover fuzzy meaning. Choose retrieval by question complexity, permissions, latency, and budget Simple, high-volume lookups still justify conventional RAG https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YLkSfz3EFGw

slides.title: AI News Odyssey 3: Interactive AI Worlds Odyssey,
slides.text: AI News Odyssey 3: Interactive AI Worlds Odyssey, a California AI company, launched Odyssey 3 In public research preview It generates explorable worlds from prompts, responding continuously to movement and events. Learned physics helps address the challenge of predicting how environments change Potentially supporting robot control and AI-agent training Odyssey 3 Pro reported 66.1 on Physics-IQ Verified using best-of-eight sampling; this is not its standard score https://x.com/testingcatalog/status/2108246975883751665 Demonstrations include robot arms and driving in India, requiring additional control policies rather than the model alone. Interactive simulation could expand training and creative applications https://odyssey.systems https://odyssey.systems/meet-odyssey-3

slides.text: AI News Step 5 Preview for Coding Agents StepFun released Step 5 Preview f or coding agents and professional workflows, including finance 600 Bln params, MoE Supports text, images, video, tool calling 1M tokens input context window, 64K output Agents can inspect projects, edit files, run tests, and iterate. Available through OpenRouter and existing coding tools https://www.stepfun.com/step-5-preview https://openrouter.ai/stepfun/step-5-preview https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bqS3oZQgAhg Laminar Flow-1: Detecting Agent Failures Laminar launched flow-1 inside its Signals platform to investigate AI agent execution traces Reinforcement-learning-trained flow-1 searches trace steps and returns structured explanations of errors Affordable continuous monitoring helps businesses verify automation rather than trust completion claims. https://laminar.sh/blog/flow-1 https://laminar.sh

slides.title: AI News Alibaba QwenGyre - Long-Horizon Agent RL
slides.text: AI News Alibaba QwenGyre - Long-Horizon Agent RL A training framework, not a model Running on multi-node GPU clusters, it trains coding agents through unmodified harnesses on tasks lasting hours, with approximately 700,000 tokens per rollout Dynamically moves GPUs between execution and training, then reconstructs, scores, and deduplicates histories into bounded training samples On Qwen 3.8 2.4T, NL2RepoBench success increased from 52.5% to 58.5% in 48 steps Training accelerated up to 1.85x, making lengthy repository-building agent training more computationally efficient https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33848

slides.title: AI News Black Forest Labs releases FLUX 3
slides.text: AI News Black Forest Labs releases FLUX 3 Image New image model with pixel-perfect editing over many turns Bounding boxes control where things go in the picture Generates natively at up to 4K Combines up to 10 reference images in one picture Accurate typography for text in images Commercial weights available now; open weights come next https://bfl.ai/models/flux-3-image Microsoft unveils Maia 300, its third in-house AI chip 3rd generation of Microsoft's AI accelerator, built for inference Claims 40% more tokens per megawatt than leading GPU systems Large-scale deployment starts in 2027 Goal: depend less on NVIDIA and AMD chips Joins Google TPUs and Amazon Trainium in the custom-chip race https://news.microsoft.com/maia-2026/ GPT-6 becomes the ChatGPT default GPT-6 Sol for paid tiers, GPT-6 Luna for Free and Go Reaches ChatGPT's 1.2 Bln weekly users Answers can include charts, forms, buttons and small tools A compiler streams native components while the model writes GPT-6 Instant web-search - answers 44% sooner GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast : up to 8x faster, $12 / $60 per 1M tokens https://links.tldrnewsletter.com/jzR1OT/1/010001a11bcb0cee-9ff72ec9-51ce-4456-9da7-54a384371a80-000000/KMPLg6QPwYc4tenSvqLS20N1U8oP0eU9p1-AUH0fidQ=452

slides.text: AI News Claude Managed Agents - 1,000 agents "Dynamic Workflows" , in public beta A lead agent writes a plan, then multiple agents work Up to 1,000 worker agents per run Results are merged at the end No hand-written coordinator or subagent roster needed Token use is high, the model does not see the spending limit https://www.latent.space/p/claude-dynamic-workflows Grok Bot will route tasks to Claude, Midjourney and Suno Grok Bot becomes an orchestrator, not a single-model assistant Claude Opus 5.5, Midjourney for images, Suno for music Announced after reports of Grok access problems on mobile and web https://thenextweb.com/news/grok-bot-claude-opus-midjourney-suno-musk

slides.title: AI News Perplexity open-sources SPACE, a sandbox for
slides.text: AI News Perplexity open-sources SPACE, a sandbox for AI agents Isolates each agent in a virtual machine Blocks unauthorized access and data leaks Top models made 118 breakout attempts; none escaped https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/blog/open-sourcing-space https://github.com/perplexityai/SPACE JPMorgan blocks outside AI agents from customer accounts Outside agents may not log in with customer credentials They cannot move money or pay bills in retail accounts Read-only data sharing through approved connectors still works https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/13/jpmorgan-ai-agents-account-access.html Google Deep Review checks technical documents An agent that gives rigorous feedback and verifies technical claims Built first for computer science papers, now covers many domains Takes PDF and plain text; multi-file input is coming Google expects such tools to help both authors and peer reviewers https://research.google/blog/analyzing-technical-documents-with-deep-review/
